intents.name: direct_messages
intents.answer: You can send direct messages to any NoteStandard user. Open the Chat tab, tap the new message icon, search for their username or select from your contacts, and start chatting.

intents.name: group_chats
intents.answer: To create a group chat: Open the Chat tab, tap 'New Group', select participants, give the group a name, and tap Create. Group admins can add/remove members and change group info.

intents.name: delivery_ticks
intents.answer: NoteStandard message status indicators: Single grey tick (✓) = Sent to server. Double grey ticks (✓✓) = Delivered to recipient's device. Double blue ticks (✓✓) = Read by recipient.

intents.name: media_sharing
intents.answer: You can share photos, videos, audio voice notes, PDF documents, and location pins in chats. Tap the paperclip icon in the message input bar to attach files up to 50MB.

intents.name: voice_video_calls
intents.answer: NoteStandard supports high-quality 1-on-1 audio and video calls powered by Agora RTC. Open any direct chat and tap the phone icon (Audio Call) or camera icon (Video Call) at the top. Ensure microphone and camera permissions are granted in your browser or device settings.

intents.name: push_notifications_troubleshooting
intents.answer: If you are not receiving push notifications when offline or in background: 1. Go to Settings > Notifications in NoteStandard and ensure Push Alerts are toggled ON. 2. Verify that site notifications are allowed in your browser settings (Chrome/Safari/Edge). 3. On mobile devices, ensure Battery Saver mode is not restricting NoteStandard background activity.

intents.name: disappearing_messages
intents.answer: To enable self-destructing messages: Open Chat Options > Disappearing Messages. Choose a duration (e.g., 24 hours, 7 days). Messages sent after turning this on will automatically delete for both parties after the timer expires.

intents.name: message_translation
intents.answer: NoteStandard can automatically translate incoming messages into your preferred language. Long-press any message and tap 'Translate', or enable Auto-Translate in Settings > Chat Preferences > Preferred Language.

intents.name: user_blocking
intents.answer: To block a user: Open their chat, tap their profile name at the top, scroll down and tap 'Block User'. Blocked users cannot message you, call you, or see your online presence. You can unblock them at any time in Settings > Blocked Users.

intents.name: mute_notifications
intents.answer: To mute a noisy chat or group: Open the chat options menu and tap 'Mute'. Select duration (8 hours, 1 week, or Always). Muted chats will not trigger sound or push notifications.

intents.name: offline_messaging
intents.answer: If you send messages while offline, NoteStandard safely queues them locally. Once your internet connection restores, your queued messages auto-deliver automatically.
